name: repeated greeting loop without engagement
description: Tests the engine's ability to detect and gracefully handle a user who repeatedly says hello without providing substantive content. Verifies that repeated greetings beyond the threshold (2) are classified as statements and trigger the language-specific repeatedGreetingResponses pool rather than being treated as fresh conversation starts.

expected.finalTurn: After REPEATED_GREETING_THRESHOLD (2) consecutive greeting utterances, subsequent greetings are classified as 'statement' rather than 'greeting', and trigger repeatedGreetingResponses which acknowledge the repetition and invite a fresh start.
expected.behavior: The engine's repeated-greeting detection reclassifies excessive consecutive greetings as statements (no greeting topic assigned). The response uses the repeatedGreetingResponses pool (acknowledging the loop and inviting fresh engagement) instead of a standard greeting or generic fallback.
